headline: Western Australian Coalmine Cuts Night Operations, Lowering Output by Half
summary: One of Western Australia's remaining operational coalmines will shut night operations, reducing productive capacity by nearly 50% and triggering union warnings of job cuts.
why: Coal supply remains critical for baseload power generation in specific regional grids undergoing energy transition shifts.

impacts.name: Coal Mining
impacts.why: Halving operational capacity lowers regional coal output and reduces headcounts.
